definitions.explanation: The state of having eaten enough and feeling full. A more formal word compared to the casual お{腹|なか}いっぱい.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{満腹|まんぷく}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I ate a lot and I'm full.

examples.japanese: {満腹|まんぷく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate until I was completely full.

examples.japanese: {満腹|まんぷく}⟦{中枢|ちゅうすう}→中枢：11373_chuusuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刺激|しげき}→刺激：03166_shigeki⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{満|まん} (full) + {腹|ぷく} (stomach/belly)

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{空腹|くうふく}→空腹：06532_kuufuku⟧ (empty stomach/hunger) - antonym
・⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦いっぱい→いっぱい：01793_ippai⟧ (I'm full - casual)
・⟦{腹八分|はらはちぶ}→腹八分：noentry⟧ (eating until 80% full - health principle)
・⟦{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ→食べ過ぎ：28819_tabesugi⟧ (overeating)

EXPRESSIONS:
・{満腹|まんぷく}{感|かん} (feeling of fullness)
・{満腹|まんぷく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become full)
・⟦{腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}→腹八分目：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦いらず→要る：09589_iru⟧ (Eating in moderation keeps the doctor away - proverb)

SCIENTIFIC CONTEXT:
・{満腹|まんぷく}⟦{中枢|ちゅうすう}→中枢：11373_chuusuu⟧ (satiety center - in the brain)
・{満腹|まんぷく}⟦ホルモン→ホルモン：noentry⟧ (satiety hormones like leptin)

DINING CULTURE:
・Saying ⟦ごちそうさまでした→ごちそうさま：00929_gochisousama⟧ indicates satisfaction with the meal
・Japanese portion sizes often aim for ⟦{腹八分|はらはちぶ}→腹八分：noentry⟧ (80% full)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{満腹|まんぷく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become full)
・{満腹|まんぷく}{感|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to feel satisfied/full)
・{満腹|まんぷく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}けない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧ (so full I can't move)
